Overview

Adana is a city in Adana with a population of 2,263,000. A major agricultural and industrial center on the Seyhan River, famous for its kebab and cotton production. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
